review_kind: author analysis, not an independent review
root_cause: calibration_runtime called torch.cuda reset/synchronize/max_memory_allocated/max_memory_reserved without a device, so a rank working on a GPU other than device 0 read zero peak allocation, classified its canvas as measurement_not_positive, and raised no_canvas_could_be_measured.
fix: Device-explicit CUDA surface in calibration_runtime; calibration.py passes the model's device; two CPU regression tests added.
unresolved: Ranks 0, 6 and 7 published nothing; the cause is not recoverable because GetJobLog returns business InternalError on this deployment. Mitigation added: per-rank stderr capture and a diagnostic message on no_canvas_could_be_measured.
